scenarios.instruction: Inspect the pelican, bicycle and sunny beach in the initial scene.
Observe the scene over time and use any supplied camera interaction.
Resize and reload without demanding unrequested pause or gameplay controls; HTML packaging/engine constraints are not inferred from a screenshot.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
